list.name: group
list.query: SELECT group_name FROM groups WHERE owner = ${__user.login:sqlstring}

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(mr.created_date, '${interval}') , COUNT(*) FROM merge_requests mr JOIN repos r ON r.id = mr.repo_id WHERE r.group_name = ${group:sqlstring} ${repo_filter:raw} AND r.id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM repo_access WHERE login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1
